name: Iterative Depth Volume Rendering (IDVR)
aliases: IDVR (Iterative Depth Volume Rendering) with Skip-Step Optimization
definition: An interactive volume rendering technique that removes the brain in front of a clipping surface to expose deeper structures, using an iterative search for the closest valid voxel (V or Vd) along view rays to determine depth and opacity.
summary: Iterative Depth Volume Rendering (IDVR) reveals internal brain structures by iteratively searching for the closest valid voxel along view rays, distinguished by its skip-step optimization that manages performance without early termination.
